title: Full-Stack Modern Web Starter (14 Days)
description: A 14-day intensive roadmap covering modern Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, API endpoints, and cloud database fundamentals.

weeks.title: Week 1 - Architecture & Frontend Fundamentals
weeks.description: Set up modern developer environment, master React Server Components, and build accessible UI components.
weeks.deliverable: A responsive multi-page dashboard scaffold with theme toggle and mock data.
weeks.objective: Build solid fundamentals in Next.js App Router and TypeScript.
reviewChecklist: Repository initialized with ESLint and Prettier

days.title: Day 1 - Next.js 15 App Router & TypeScript Setup
days.description: Initialize a clean project, configure strict TypeScript rules, and understand the App Router directory structure.
objectives: Set up strict tsconfig options and path aliases

tasks.title: Initialize Next.js project with Tailwind and App Router
Configure path aliases and theme provider
Read Next.js Server Components mental model guide

days.title: Day 2 - Design System & Component Architecture
days.description: Build atomic UI primitives using Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons, and accessible focus states.
objectives: Create reusable Button, Card, Badge, and Input components

tasks.title: Create reusable Button component with variant states
Build responsive navigation sidebar and header

weeks.title: Week 2 - APIs, Databases & Deployment
weeks.description: Connect cloud persistence, implement route handlers, and deploy to production.
weeks.deliverable: A fully deployed web application with live cloud database integration.
weeks.objective: Complete full-stack integration and production CI/CD.

days.title: Day 3 - Backend API Route Handlers
days.description: Design REST endpoints, validate input with Zod, and handle error responses.
objectives: Write typed GET and POST route handlers
Add request schema validation using Zod

tasks.title: Build /api/items GET and POST route handlers
Add error status codes (400, 401, 500) and logging

days.title: Day 4 - Cloud Database & Deployment
days.description: Connect to cloud MongoDB Atlas or Postgres, verify CRUD queries, and push to production.
objectives: Configure connection pooling and environment variables
Deploy to Vercel and test production URLs

tasks.title: Connect MongoDB Atlas client with connection pooling
Deploy to Vercel and verify live production sync
